title: Pilot Lane Activation Guide and Release Notes Cadence
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose:
This doc defines the end-to-end activation runway for pilot customers (Pilot Lane), the cadence and owner map for release notes, and an operational checklist to move pilots from first-traffic to production-ready customers. It is intended for PMs, Eng, Design, Solutions Eng, Support, and GTM stakeholders.

Objectives:
- Ensure predictable, low-friction onboarding for 6 pilot customers across hosted and dedicated deployments.
- Align release notes and comms so customers understand scope, migration steps, and any temporary limitations.
- Define telemetry gates and success criteria to graduate pilots or trigger rollback/mitigation.

High-level timeline (week-level):
- Week -4 (Prep): finalize pilot config templates, release-note draft, and telemetry dashboards. Owners: PM/Luca; Eng: infra readiness.
- Week -2 (Invite): send pilot invites, configuration checklist, and support SLOs to customers. Owner: Solutions Eng.
- Week 0 (Launch): enable pilot access, monitor early KPIs, daily standups for first 3 days.
- Week 2 (Evaluate): review success criteria and decide to continue, broaden, or pause.

Success criteria (must meet all):
- Latency p50 <= 120ms and p95 <= 500ms for typical traffic profile OR documented mitigation in place (caching/quantization).
- Error rate < 0.5% sustained across 24h (excluding known scheduled maintenance).
- Customer completes integration checklist and submits 3 representative prompts for quality evaluation.
- No critical security/regulatory blockers flagged in initial audit.

Release notes cadence & template (owner: Product):
- Draft (D-10): PM prepares feature summary, migration impact, and known limitations. Link: https://confluence.company.redwood/pilot-release-notes-drafts/PM-337201
- Technical appendix (D-7): Eng provides compatibility notes, required config changes, and fallback behavior (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pilot-configs/pull/128).
- Legal/Compliance review (D-5): security signs off on any data handling language; KMS/HSM notes if applicable.
- Final publish (D-2): Support templates and customer-facing changelog published to Drive and GH wiki.

Release note template (single-paragraph output we will include in changelog):
- What changed: short plain-language summary.
- Impact: who it affects and whether action is required.
- Rollback/fallback: how we mitigate regressions.
- Known limitations: list with temporary workarounds.

Operational checklist (pre-launch):
- Pilot config repo reviewed and tagged (ENG).
- Default quota and rate-limits set for pilot tenants (Platform).
- Alerting/Oncall runbook updated with pilot channel and escalation path (SRE).
- Customer onboarding document shared and signed off (Solutions Eng).
- Release notes draft linked in invite email (PM).

Telemetry gating (owner: PM + Observability eng):
- Dashboards: per-tenant token-level breakdown, route-level latency, cost-per-token estimate. Link: https://dashboards.redwood/pilot-activation
- Automated gate: if p95 latency > 750ms for >30m, trigger auto-canary-fallback (route to lower-cost variant) and notify oncall.
- Quality gate: if automated eval score on the 3 customer prompts drops >10% vs baseline, pause rollout and kick off Quality Incident Review.

Communication plan (audiences & cadence):
- Internal daily standup (first 72h): PM/Eng/Design/Support.
- Weekly sync: pilot cohort status report + telemetry highlights to GTM.
- Customer updates: Kickoff email, Day 3 health check, Week 2 retrospective + success decision.

RACI summary (key roles):
- Product (PM): overall pilot orchestration, release notes finalization, success decision.
- Engineering (Infra & Runtime): implement config, provide compatibility notes, remediation.
- Design: assist with customer UX flows and in-product messaging for migration.
- Solutions Eng: hands-on onboarding, runbooks, customer playbooks.
- Support/SRE: oncall coverage and SLA responses.

Fallback & rollback plan:
- Soft-fallback: route affected routes to a conservative model variant and enable prefix caching (fast revert, documented).
- Full rollback: revert tenant flags and redeploy previous model package if issue persists >2h and incident severity >= Sev2.
- Post-mortem: required for any rollback; PM to coordinate with Eng and Support within 72h.

Known trade-offs & decisions made:
- Trade-off: We will prioritize latency SLOs over small quality regressions for the first 72h to reduce customer disruption. Decision logged 2026-02-20 by PM.
- Trade-off: Release notes will call out expected differences between hosted and dedicated behavior rather than attempting to unify across both in the first pilot wave. This reduces engineering timelines but requires clearer customer comms.
